803:t_1:86.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's not out of the question...」

803:t_1:87.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I expect Miss $$スズネ$$ will make her moves to match $n's.」

803:t_1:88.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ also seems to treat $n as someone special. We'll need to be careful.」

803:t_1:89.en:
$$シャア$$
「What do you plan to do, $$ブライト$$?」

803:t_1:91.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Assign to the Japan Defense Force」
「Assign to the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ containment force」
「Assign to the $$アマルガム$$ pursuit force」

803:t_1:92.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Japan will play an important role in the great counteroffensive to come, too. Let's have him take up its defense.」

803:t_1:93.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll make the arrangements accordingly.」

803:t_1:94.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If this operation goes well, $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ will enter its final phase.」

803:t_1:95.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$... We will defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and the Reactors, and free the people trapped in the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

803:t_1:96.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That day will be the moment Earth is liberated. Keep that in mind, everyone, and carry out your missions.」

803:t_1:97.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If we don't stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$, a prolonged war is inevitable. We'll have him join that mission as well.」

803:t_1:98.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll make the arrangements accordingly.」

803:t_1:99.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If this operation goes well, $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ will enter its final phase.」

803:t_1:100.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$... We will defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and the Reactors, and free the people trapped in the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

803:t_1:101.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That day will be the moment Earth is liberated. Keep that in mind, everyone, and carry out your missions.」

803:t_1:102.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Leaving $$アマルガム$$, who developed the $$時空震動弾$$, alone is dangerous. We'll have him join that mission as well.」

803:t_1:103.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Understood. I'll make the arrangements accordingly.」

803:t_1:104.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If this operation goes well, $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ will enter its final phase.」

803:t_1:105.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$... We will defeat Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ and the Reactors, and free the people trapped in the $$霊子吸収システム$$...」

803:t_1:106.en:
$$ブライト$$
「That day will be the moment Earth is liberated. Keep that in mind, everyone, and carry out your missions.」

803:t_1:110.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

803:t_1:111.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「...Whew, that's something. $c is getting stronger.」

803:t_1:114.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now that I can finally talk freely, let's liven things up a little, okay?」

803:t_1:115.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Expecting that from these guys is a lost cause.」

803:t_1:116.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Mind your tongue, half-baked. You're only here as a matter of convenience.」

803:t_1:117.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「How petty. There are twelve chairs in here, so there's plenty of room, isn't there?」

803:t_1:118.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Exactly. Just me and two gloomy men would be stifling.」

803:t_1:119.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What is $$アウストラリス$$ doing?」

803:t_1:120.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Official business. His Majesty the Emperor is busy.」

803:t_1:124.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm used to handling cocky little boys.」

803:t_1:126.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「All right, all right! No flying off the handle for real! We're the Reactors, bound together by strong ties, after all!」

803:t_1:129.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ignoring the Supreme Commander's words isn't very nice...」

803:t_1:131.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「There's no report to give, it's just as I said. They're definitely getting stronger.」

803:t_1:132.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Compared to when they were struggling against $$ガドライト#pilot$$ in the dimensional cage, it's lightning-fast progress.」

803:t_1:133.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「In a sense, you have yourselves to thank. When those guys get pinned down, they have a habit of throwing it off with more power than ever.」

803:t_1:134.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've certainly taken their side.」

803:t_1:135.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's not about individuals... Anyway, it beats being obsessed with one particular woman, doesn't it?」

803:t_1:137.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$バルビエル$$. Pay this woman no mind.」

803:t_1:138.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Right, right. $c has come back to $$蒼の地球$$. Let's have plenty of fun, shall we?」

803:t_1:139.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Indeed. Crushing their arrogance wouldn't be bad, either.」

803:t_1:140.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「When they move, the monstrous gods who target this planet will move too.」

803:t_1:141.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「A being that draws battle along with it... A true $$特異点$$, isn't it.」

803:t_1:142.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「That's why they bear the $$烙印$$. ...Same as us.」

803:t_1:143.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
(Now then... $c, $n... These guys mean business now.)

803:t_1:144.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
(Can you win with what you've got...?)

803:t_1:148.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace ～

803:t_1:149.en:
$$グエン$$
「...That concludes the activity report on the forces under $$クロノ$$'s control.」

803:t_1:152.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「$$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$... Why did you become a member of $$クロノ$$?」

803:t_1:153.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I have heard in the reports that $$クロノ$$'s core members are hereditary, and that barring extraordinary circumstances, vacancies are never filled.」

803:t_1:154.en:
$$グエン$$
「...It may be a kind of resignation.」

803:t_1:156.en:
$$グエン$$
「I came to know where the world is headed by means other than the $$黒の英知$$.」

803:t_1:157.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「So that's the book called 《$$メトロポリス$$》...」

803:t_1:158.en:
$$グエン$$
「Unlike $$クロノ$$'s $$キング$$, I have no sense of mission. I'm just small fry.」

803:t_1:159.en:
$$グエン$$
「But small fry that I am, in my own way I want to see the end of the species called Earth's humanity through.」

803:t_1:160.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You take a very detached view.」

803:t_1:161.en:
$$グエン$$
「It's nothing so grand. I merely know my own limits.」

803:t_1:163.en:
$$グエン$$
「If I have relieved Your Majesty's boredom, it is an honor. ...Now, if you will excuse me.」

803:t_1:164.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「One who bears witness to the end of a species...」

803:t_1:165.en:
$$執務官$$
「Your Majesty... The next person is waiting.」

803:t_1:168.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「State your name, woman.」

803:t_1:169.en:
$$シオニー$$
「My name is $$シオニー・レジス$$.」

803:t_1:170.en:
$$シオニー$$
「I have something I wish to tell Your Majesty today, which is why I requested an audience.」
